mapper.select: select id, strategyId, awardId, awardCount, awardRate, createTime, updateTime from strategy_detail where strategyId = #{strategyId}
select awardId from strategy_detail where strategyId = #{strategyId} and awardSurplusCount = 0
mapper.update: update strategy_detail set awardSurplusCount = awardSurplusCount - 1 where awardSurplusCount > 0 and strategyId = #{strategyId} and awardId = #{awardId}
